title: Netflix Awards Catalog: Complete List of Academy Award®, Emmy®, Golden Globe® and BAFTA Wins and Nominations
summary: Netflix’s current nominations and past wins at the Academy Awards®, Primetime Emmy® Awards, Golden Globes, BAFTA Film Awards, and BAFTA Television Awards
body_markdown:
We’re incredibly proud of the Netflix films, series and specials that have received awards over the years. They are testaments to the immensely talented artists in front of and behind the camera who bring their very best work to Netflix, making us a global destination for exceptional storytelling.


On September 14, 2026, Netflix received the following 3 Primetime Emmy® Award wins. These 3 wins, along with our previously announced 13 award wins, brings Netflix’s win total to 16.


Netflix highlights include Sally Field becoming the oldest Emmy winner in the Lead Actress in a Limited or Anthology Series or Movie category, and Matthew Rhys is the first actor to win in both Lead Actor in a Limited or Anthology series or Movie and Lead Actor in a Comedy Series.


OUTSTANDING LEAD ACTOR IN A LIMITED OR ANTHOLOGY SERIES OR MOVIE


Matthew Rhys, The Beast in Me


OUTSTANDING SUPPORTING ACTRESS IN A DRAMA SERIES


Allison Janney, The Diplomat


OUTSTANDING LEAD ACTRESS IN A LIMITED OR ANTHOLOGY SERIES OR MOVIE


Sally Field, Remarkably Bright Creatures


OUTSTANDING UNSTRUCTURED REALITY PROGRAM


Love on the Spectrum


OUTSTANDING CASTING FOR A REALITY PROGRAM


Love on the Spectrum


OUTSTANDING PICTURE EDITING FOR AN UNSTRUCTURED REALITY PROGRAM


Love on the Spectrum “Episode 4”


OUTSTANDING PICTURE EDITING FOR A NONFICTION PROGRAM


Sean Combs: The Reckoning “Blink Again”


OUTSTANDING MOVIE


Remarkably Bright Creatures


OUTSTANDING CHARACTER VOICE-OVER PERFORMANCE


Julie Andrews, Bridgerton


OUTSTANDING MUSIC COMPOSITION FOR A LIMITED OR ANTHOLOGY SERIES, MOVIE OR SPECIAL (ORIGINAL DRAMATIC SCORE)


The Beast in Me “The Beast in Me”


OUTSTANDING CONTEMPORARY COSTUMES FOR A LIMITED OR ANTHOLOGY SERIES OR MOVIE


BEEF “All The Things We’re Never Going To Have”


OUTSTANDING PERIOD OR FANTASY/SCI-FI HAIRSTYLING


Bridgerton “The Waltz”


OUTSTANDING PICTURE EDITING FOR A MULTI-CAMERA COMEDY SERIES


Leanne “Having Big Feelings”


OUTSTANDING SOUND EDITING FOR A LIMITED OR ANTHOLOGY SERIES, MOVIE OR SPECIAL


BEEF “It Will Stay This Way and You Will Obey”


OUTSTANDING SOUND MIXING FOR A LIMITED OR ANTHOLOGY SERIES OR MOVIE


BEEF “It Will Stay This Way and You Will Obey”

Stranger Things
